## Signal vs. Noise

**What moved the needle this week?**
*List 2-3 things that actually advanced important outcomes.*

1. IMAPAC presentation to 300 people in English — milestone public speaking event. Observed 4 tiers of presenters: (1) reading transcripts, (2) unprepared/too much Mandarin, (3) memorized & fluent without notes, (4) storytelling beyond slides with natural English. **One thing I learned outside my function this week:**
Two days of external engagement exposed a key gap: interpersonal communication and composure at the CXO level. Technical knowledge (pharma + AI) is already at a competitive level among peers, but the differentiator for CXO readiness is presence — how you speak, respond, and carry yourself in unscripted moments. Observed this in EirGenix chairman (70 yrs old, decades of experience) as the benchmark.

Specific growth areas identified:
- **Q&A composure** — missed an adjuvant question directly related to company business despite AI-generated prep questions
- **Impromptu response** — voice projection, body language, thinking on feet
- **Storytelling in English** — transitioning from memorized delivery to natural narrative
- "Think on Your Feet" framework via Articulate app helps slide structure and logical flow, but live Q&A remains the real test
- Potential project idea: AI-powered daily practice interface for impromptu speaking and interaction logging
